title: The Turkish Feeding/Swallowing Impact Survey
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the reliability and validity of the Turkish Feeding/Swallowing Impact Survey among caregivers of pediatric patients with swallowing disorders.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Having a child with swallowing disorders aged between 6 months-18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Having a child without swallowing disorders
* Having a child with swallowing disorders aged below 6 months
study_population: Caregivers of pediatric patients with swallowing disorders
